summary: E2E frontend testing of Digital Twin — Next Stage features (A: Comparison, B: Offer from verified concept, C: Validation notifications, D: Real materials + indicative prices). Verified as CLIENT + OPERATOR. Features A, C, D and B(success flow) work end-to-end. One minor UX gap in Feature B (unverified state): the 'offer-locked' Romanian message is NOT rendered inside the DesignConceptStudio ConceptResult panel — it only renders inside the ConceptComparison column. Regression on existing DT flow OK.

ui_bugs.issue: For an inferred/unverified concept the 'offer-locked' text ('Oferta se poate cere doar dintr-un concept validat profesional') is NOT rendered in the concept result panel. The RequestOfferButton is only mounted when status === 'verified' (line 107-109 of DesignConceptStudio.jsx: `{(status === 'verified' || c.confidence === 'verified') && <RequestOfferButton .../>}`). Because RequestOfferButton is the component that renders the `offer-locked` node when unverified, gating it behind `verified` means unverified concepts never show the lock message. The spec explicitly requires: 'On a freshly generated (inferred, unverified) concept, the offer area must show offer-locked text, NOT the request-offer-btn.' Fix: always mount `<RequestOfferButton concept={c} />` (it already internally decides to render either offer-locked or the button). The ConceptComparison column already does this correctly and offer-locked is visible there.

rca of the issue: Feature B unverified-lock: In DesignConceptStudio.jsx (ConceptResult), the developer wrapped <RequestOfferButton> in a conditional that only renders when the concept is verified. However, RequestOfferButton itself is designed to render either the offer-locked notice (unverified) OR the button (verified) OR the offer-requested chip. By adding the outer verified-only gate, the unverified branch of RequestOfferButton is never reached from the studio result view. Reproduction: as client, open dt-open-design → generate a concept → observe result panel — there is no offer-locked chip. Mitigation: replace lines 107-109 with `{c.id && <RequestOfferButton concept={c} />}` (unconditional). The comparison overlay column (ConceptColumn) already does this and correctly shows offer-locked.
